title: Repo map, artifact manifest, crate generator, domain generator (G-003/G-004/G-006/G-007)
objective: Implement master source Epic G's repo-tooling backlog: a deterministic repo map (G-003), a deterministic artifact manifest sourced from real ABI data (G-004), a Rust crate scaffolding generator (G-006), and a domain scaffolding generator (G-007) that reuses it, without creating any permanent speculative crate/domain in the real tree.
validations: cargo test --workspace: all green (includes capi-bridge's 23 tests, unaffected by EngineAbiInfo::current()'s pub(crate) -> pub widening)
cargo check --workspace: clean (abi-info-cli feature-gated bin does not affect the default/real cdylib build)
cargo run -p grafting-isekai-capi --features abi-info-cli --bin abi-info-cli: real JSON output confirmed matching EngineAbiInfo::current()
node tools/scripts/generate-repo-map.mjs then --check: current, 13 real projects
node tools/scripts/generate-artifact-manifest.mjs then --check: current (excluding gitSha/target, which legitimately vary per run/machine)

node --test tools/scripts/generate-rust-crate.test.mjs tools/scripts/generate-domain.test.mjs: 5/5 passing, including real pnpm exec nx show projects --json discoverability assertions against in-repo scratch crates, and real cargo check against them
git status --short confirmed no leftover scratch directories after generator tests ran
uv run --package automation python -m automation.coordination --root .: passed
risks: Nx's default project-graph construction does not scan OS temp directories or .gitignore'd paths -- generator tests scaffold into a real, non-ignored, in-repo scratch location to actually prove Nx discoverability, not a true OS tmpdir (confirmed empirically before writing the tests).

Root Cargo.toml's [workspace] members array is explicit, not a glob -- the crate/domain generators' members-array append logic is real, load-bearing text manipulation, tested separately (start/middle/end insertion, idempotency) against a scratch copy, never the real file during tests.

A scratch crate nested inside the real repo tree is not automatically a standalone Cargo unit -- Cargo refuses to check it as an implicit workspace member unless it opts out via its own empty [workspace] table (confirmed empirically); the tests append that only after asserting the real generator template's content, so it never affects what a real invocation scaffolds.

Codex's concurrently in-progress I-003B-TYPESCRIPT-PUBLIC-API-PILOT also declared CURRENT_PLANNING_STATE.md/GRAFTING_MASTER_SOURCE.md and sent a codex-to-claude handoff asking to defer edits to them -- received after this task's edits to both files had already landed. Verified directly (grep) that no I-003B narrative content existed yet in either file at that point and that G-TOOLING's own new sections are intact, not duplicated or corrupted; sent a claude-to-codex response handoff explaining the actual sequencing and confirming both paths are now released (no further edits planned from this task).

abi-info-cli's JSON output is hand-written (no serde_json dependency added to capi-bridge purely for this CLI) -- low risk given the flat, small shape, but would need revisiting if the manifest's real shape ever grows nested/complex.
